description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Kelpie Guide ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Kelpie Guide abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater
